section.title: My Journey as a
section.description: From learning the fundamentals to exploring modern full-stack development, every step has been about learning, building, and improving.

journey.title: The Beginning
journey.subtitle: Where my development journey started
journey.description: My journey into web development started with curiosity about how websites work. I began exploring the fundamentals of web pages, structure, styling, and the ideas behind modern websites.

journey.title: Web Fundamentals
journey.subtitle: Building a strong foundation
journey.description: I focused on understanding HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Instead of only focusing on the final visual result, I started learning how structure, styling, and programming logic work together.

journey.title: Entering React
journey.subtitle: Learning component-based development
journey.description: React changed the way I thought about building interfaces. I started breaking large interfaces into smaller reusable components and learning how state and interaction work together.

journey.title: Modern Web Development
journey.subtitle: Moving toward modern application development
journey.description: I started working with TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS to build more structured, responsive, and maintainable applications.

journey.title: Backend & APIs
journey.subtitle: Going beyond the interface
journey.description: After becoming comfortable with frontend development, I started exploring backend concepts to understand what happens behind the interface and how applications communicate with servers.

journey.title: Working With Data
journey.subtitle: Understanding application data
journey.description: As applications became more complex, I started learning how data is structured, stored, queried, and connected with application logic.

journey.title: DevOps & Deployment
journey.subtitle: Understanding the bigger picture
journey.description: I expanded my development knowledge into version control, containerization, servers, cloud infrastructure, and deployment workflows.

journey.title: What's Next
journey.subtitle: The journey continues
journey.description: Development is a continuous learning process. My goal is to keep improving my fundamentals, build more real-world applications, strengthen my full-stack knowledge, and become a better problem solver.

closing.title: The journey is
closing.description: Every project is another opportunity to learn something new, solve a problem, and become a better developer.
